 --> PM Kisan 24th instalment today: PM Modi to release Rs 18,680 crore for 9.34 crore farmers at 10 am; check eligibility, status
 The previous, or 23rd, instalment was transferred to the accounts of 9.44 crore farmers. This time, the beneficiary count has declined by more than 10 lakh. 
 Moneycontrol News 
 October 30, 2026 / 07:40 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Under the PM-KISAN scheme, eligible farmer families receive financial assistance of Rs 6,000 annually in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 each. PM Modi releases 24th PM-KISAN instalment of Rs 2,000.
 Over 9.34 crore farmers to receive total funds of Rs 18,680 cr.
 Beneficiaries must complete eKYC to receive the funds.

 The wait for the 24th instalment of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Yojana will end today, October 30, as Prime Minister Narendra Modi releases funds to farmers at an event in Bhildi in Gujarat's Banaskantha district.
 The Prime Minister is scheduled to begin the programme at 10 am and transfer Rs 2,000 each directly into the bank accounts of 9.34 crore eligible farmers. The government will release a total of Rs 18,680 crore under the scheme.
 With this, farmers will receive the 24th instalment of the PM-KISAN scheme. The previous, or 23rd, instalment was transferred to the accounts of 9.44 crore farmers. This time, the beneficiary count has declined by more than 10 lakh.
 Under the PM-KISAN scheme, eligible farmer families receive financial assistance of Rs 6,000 annually in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 each.
 Farmers can check their beneficiary status and verify whether their names appear on the list through the official PM-KISAN portal, pmkisan.gov.in.
 Related Stories

 How to check PM-KISAN instalment status 
 Farmers can visit pmkisan.gov.in, navigate to the beneficiary status section and enter the required details to check the status of their instalment. The portal also allows beneficiaries to check their names on the beneficiary list.
 Is eKYC mandatory for PM-KISAN beneficiaries? 
 Beneficiaries need to complete their eKYC to receive the instalment. Farmers can complete the process themselves through the PM-KISAN mobile app without paying any fee. Those who use the services of a Common Service Centre (CSC) can be charged a facilitation fee of Rs 15.
 PM-KISAN beneficiaries can also get Rs 3,000 monthly pension 
 Farmers covered under PM-KISAN can also enrol in the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana to receive a monthly pension of Rs 3,000 after attaining the age of 60, subject to eligibility conditions.
 Under the pension scheme, subscribers are required to make a monthly contribution based on their age at the time of enrolment. Eligible PM-KISAN beneficiaries can opt to have their contribution deducted from their PM-KISAN instalments.
